body:
## Pull request overview

This pull request implements four column-level advanced features for ObjectGrid: pinned columns (left/right), summary aggregations (count/sum/avg/min/max), link columns (navigation triggers), and action columns (button-style actions). The implementation builds on existing spec bridge support that was already passing these properties but had no rendering logic.

**Changes:**
- Added `useColumnSummary` hook for computing column aggregations with support for string shorthand and object configuration formats
- Implemented pinned column support with reordering logic (left-pinned first, right-pinned last with sticky CSS)
- Enhanced action columns to render as proper Shadcn Buttons instead of link-style text, with formatted action labels
- Added comprehensive test coverage (28 tests) for all aggregation types, pinned columns, link/action cells, and combined features

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 6 out of 6 changed files in this pull request and generated 9 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts | Added `pinned` and `summary` fields to ListColumnSchema Zod validator to match spec |
| packages/plugin-grid/src/useColumnSummary.ts | New hook implementing column aggregation logic with type normalization and formatting |
| packages/plugin-grid/src/index.tsx | Exported `useColumnSummary` hook and its types for external use |
| packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/column-features.test.tsx | Comprehensive test suite covering hook logic, UI rendering, and combined feature scenarios |
| packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx | Integrated all four features: pinned reordering, summary footer, link/action cell rendering with data-testid attributes |
| ROADMAP.md | Updated roadmap entries to reflect implementation status of column features |
</details>

The summary aggregation labels (Count, Sum, Avg, Min, Max) are hardcoded in English in the `formatSummaryLabel` function. For a global product, these labels should be internationalized using the i18n system. Consider using a translation key instead of hardcoded strings, similar to how other UI text in the codebase is handled. Reference the CRM example's i18n implementation at examples/crm/src/i18n/ for the pattern.

There's a logic issue in the `computeAggregation` function on line 41-42. When computing a 'count' aggregation, it returns `values.length`, which is the count of numeric values after filtering (lines 100-109). However, for 'count' aggregations, the correct behavior is handled separately on lines 113-115 which counts all non-null values regardless of type. The 'count' case in this function should never be reached because of the special handling on line 113, but having it here with incorrect logic could cause confusion. Consider removing the 'count' case from the switch statement since it's handled separately, or add a comment explaining why it's unreachable code.
```suggestion
 * Compute a single aggregation over numeric data values.
 *
 * Note: "count" aggregations are handled separately in useColumnSummary,
 * where all non-null values (not just numeric) are counted.
 */
function computeAggregation(type: string, values: number[]): number | null {
  if (values.length === 0) return null;

```

The PR title contains Chinese text "列级高级特性实现" which violates the English-only codebase requirement. All user-facing text, titles, documentation, and comments must be written in English to ensure global accessibility and consistency. Please update the PR title to use only English text, for example: "feat: Column pinned/summary/link/action — Column-Level Advanced Features Implementation"

The summary footer is only rendered when the grid is not grouped (line 1270-1275). When grouping is enabled, the summary aggregations are not displayed at all. This creates an inconsistent user experience where summary configurations on columns are silently ignored when grouping is active. Consider either: (1) rendering the summary footer after all groups in the grouped view, or (2) documenting this limitation in the PR description and adding a comment in the code explaining why summaries are not shown in grouped mode.

The implementation passes the full `data` array to `useColumnSummary` on line 364, which means summaries are computed over all data rows, not just the currently visible/filtered rows. If the grid has pagination or filtering enabled, the summary values will include data from all pages/hidden rows, which may be misleading to users who expect to see summaries only for the visible data. Consider passing the filtered/paginated data subset instead, or document this behavior clearly in the component documentation.

The action button on line 522-536 lacks an accessible label for screen readers. While the visible text shows the formatted action label, there's no aria-label or similar attribute to indicate the button's purpose in the context of the row. Consider adding an aria-label that includes context, for example: `aria-label={`${formatActionLabel(col.action!)} for ${row.name || row._id}`}` to provide screen reader users with more information about which row the action will be performed on.

The Actions column (added on lines 753-793) is added before pinned column reordering logic executes (lines 795-812). If the Actions column should always appear at the far right, it might conflict with user-specified right-pinned columns. Consider either: (1) explicitly setting `pinned: 'right'` on the Actions column so it follows the same pinning logic as other columns, or (2) adding the Actions column after the pinned reordering logic so it always appears last. The current implementation may result in unexpected column ordering when users specify right-pinned columns.
